title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Extension Term and New Expiry Date
content:
**Condition 1.** The extension term of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers is the instrument's extension months, counted in whole calendar months.

**Condition 2.** The new expiry date is the old expiry date as recorded on the credit plus the extension term in calendar months. Adding the months keeps the day of the month, and falls back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist. The credit's extension count increases by one.

## Inputs and result

| Item | Source |
|---|---|
| Extension term | the instrument's extension months |
| Old expiry date | the expiry date as recorded on the credit |
| New expiry date | old expiry date plus the extension term, same day of the month, or the last day of the month where that day does not exist |
| Extension count | increases by one |

## Worked dates (hypothetical instrument whose extension months are 6)

| Old expiry date as recorded | Extension term | New expiry date | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 January 2027 | 6 months | 15 July 2027 | day of the month kept |
| 31 May 2026 | 6 months | 30 November 2026 | 31 November does not exist; last day of November |
| 31 August 2026 | 6 months | 28 February 2027 | 31 February does not exist; last day of February |
| 31 August 2027 | 6 months | 29 February 2028 | February 2028 has 29 days |
